title: Black Ditch
shortDescription: A ditch of black water east of the peat-cut.
longDescription:
The ditch is narrower than the peat-cut and just as unwilling. Iron smell. No tea. If the lurker is still here, it is keeping shine, not a person.
South is the lintel field. West is the peat-cut. North is the stile toward the barrow.

fixtures.name: Black Water
fixtures.lookDescription: Black water with iron in it. Examine it.
fixtures.examineDescription: Peat water, black to the surface, with a bent shine down in it that catches the light and then does not. It gives back no reflection at all. Do not drink it. Kern says the ditch has always been deep here and has never held metal until this year.
